name: io.github.BartWaardenburg/isagentready-mcp
title: IsAgentReady
description: Scan websites for AI agent readiness with scores, grades and recommendations

environmentVariables.name: ISAGENTREADY_CACHE_TTL
environmentVariables.description: Response cache lifetime in seconds. Set 0 to disable the cache. Default 120.

environmentVariables.name: ISAGENTREADY_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum retry attempts for rate-limited (429) requests, with exponential backoff. Default 3.

environmentVariables.name: ISAGENTREADY_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of tool categories to enable. Default all toolsets.
